_note: One entry per city. 'station' is the NWS observation station whose hourly readings give 'today so far'. Forecasts are pulled for the station's own location, so they can be checked against what that station later records. 'history' says how today relates to the official record kept in weather-intelligence. 'record_sid' is the ACIS id of the official long record used for ranks. 'rank_today' is false where today's readings come from a different station than the record, so today's and forecast values aren't ranked against it.
